templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
templates.description: A mutual NDA created by a committee of over 40 attorneys representing technology vendors, procurement teams, boutique firms, and Big Law. This agreement is used to protect confidential information when evaluating potential business relationships. Version 1.0 of this agreement remains unchanged and hosted forever.

templates.name: Cloud Service Agreement
templates.description: An easy agreement for selling and buying cloud software and SaaS products. Created by a committee of over 40 attorneys, this CSA provides balanced terms for both vendors and customers.

templates.name: Data Processing Agreement
templates.description: A data protection agreement covering how personal data is processed. Compliant with GDPR and other data protection regulations. Defines roles and responsibilities between data controllers and processors.

templates.name: Service Level Agreement
templates.description: Defines service level expectations and remedies. Designed to be used with the Common Paper Cloud Service Agreement (CSA) for cloud software and SaaS products.

templates.name: Design Partner Agreement
templates.description: Allows a prospective customer to be one of the first users of a product and provide feedback. Perfect for early-stage vendors seeking to incorporate customer feedback into product development.

templates.name: Professional Services Agreement
templates.description: Standard agreement for providing professional services and delivering deliverables. Includes provisions for payment, intellectual property assignment, and service delivery terms.

templates.name: Software License Agreement
templates.description: Comprehensive agreement for licensing software. Covers license grants, restrictions, payment, and support terms. Suitable for both cloud and on-premise software solutions.

templates.name: Partnership Agreement
templates.description: Governs partnership relationships between companies including obligations, payment terms, trademark licenses, and dispute resolution. Flexible for various partnership models.

templates.name: Pilot Agreement
templates.description: Short-term trial agreement allowing customers to evaluate products before committing to longer-term deals. Often leads to full commercial agreements like CSA or Software License Agreement.

templates.name: Business Associate Agreement
templates.description: HIPAA-compliant agreement for relationships handling protected health information (PHI). Includes data protection, breach notification, and compliance obligations.

templates.name: AI Addendum
templates.description: Addendum addressing artificial intelligence and machine learning usage in technology agreements. Covers AI services, training data, output ownership, and related intellectual property provisions.
